name: Capital Futures Corporation
summary: Capital Futures Corporation engages in futures brokerage business in Taiwan, rest of Asia, North America, and Europe. The company offers future and OTC services; manager business services, including balanced hedging strategy and performance announcement; i-View Strategy platform and multiCharts; structured products; and digital services. It also provides various services, such as futures settlement and delivery, trading of Taiwan and overseas futures products, proprietary trading, options market making, futures management, securities trading assistance, and project planning for futures advisory and derivative financial product research.
